rows.basis: published by the Fed (what issuers owe minus what holders were found with)
rows.flow_code: derived: issuers' net issuance minus holders' net purchases

source: Federal Reserve Board, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), table F3_4_s (amounts outstanding) and F3_4_t_tu (transactions, not seasonally adjusted), one line per holding sector
note: The share of each owner is of everything outstanding. Net bought is the Federal Reserve's quarterly net purchases; price and other changes is the change in holdings minus what was bought, which is mostly price moves. The Fed carries Treasury, agency, municipal and corporate bond totals at face value and most holders at market value, which is part of its published gap.
